000023b0: First-order filter: current+(previous-current)*(1-coefficient), with invalid previous exponent rejection and snap-to-current threshold. Units of current/previous/threshold agree; coefficient is dimensionless. The raw C (uint)arg1 is an FPU bit reinterpretation in assembly, not a numeric uint conversion.
000023dc: Absolute difference is fabsf(a-b) behavior for ordinary values, implemented with SH FPU arithmetic. This is not a one-argument fabsf routine and does not establish a libm origin.
000023e4: Ordered max: a>b ? a:b. With NaN second argument it returns that NaN, unlike newlib fmaxf which selects the numeric operand. Equal inputs choose the second operand, affecting signed zero.
000023f4: Ordered min: b>a ? a:b. With NaN second argument it returns that NaN, unlike newlib fminf. Equal inputs choose the second operand.
00002404: Assembly clamp is !(value>lower) ? lower : (upper>value ? value:upper). Raw C simplification using upper<=value is not equivalent for NaN upper. Reconstructed/rx8_math.c preserves the assembly ordering.
00007438: 7.6293945e-05 is binary32 5/65536. The MAF lookup input is raw*5/65536, consistent with a 5-V full-scale normalized ADC signal; volts is an inference until ADC representation/reference are verified, not proof of a 16-bit ADC.
0001a13c: Multiplication by engine_speed_rpm/60 changes a per-revolution quantity into per-second. Remaining factor 0.04*x+0.26 has unresolved units, so the output is not assigned a complete physical unit.
0002d318: 0.27777776 approximates 1/3.6, the km/h-to-m/s factor. Applied to an acceleration-like value and compared with +/-9.8, it suggests (km/h)/s to m/s^2; upstream timebase is not confirmed, so this remains a dimensional candidate.
